description:
intent=i026 snapshot=s05 branch=header-accessor-no-linearize status=complete
finding location=net/ncsi/ncsi-rsp.c:1113-1155 confidence=medium conclusion=ncsi_rcv_rsp, the ETH_P_NCSI packet_type handler, dereferences skb_network_header()-derived hdr->type/id/length (and feeds hdr->length into payload) with no pskb_may_pull or headlen guard, so a crafted non-linear 0x88F8 frame is read past skb_headlen (remote OOB read).
finding location=net/ncsi/ncsi-aen.c:215-229 confidence=medium conclusion=ncsi_aen_handler dereferences skb_network_header()-derived h->type and ncsi_validate_aen_pkt reads pchecksum at (h+1)+payload-4 with no linearization, so a non-linear NCSI AEN frame is read beyond the skb linear area.
unresolved location=net/ncsi/ncsi-rsp.c:52 conclusion=Follow up: read net/ncsi/ncsi-rsp.c lines 50-64 to capture verbatim the pchecksum dereference that uses the attacker-controlled payload (hdr->length) and confirm it reads bytes possibly outside the linear head.
unresolved location=net/ncsi/ncsi-rsp.c:825 conclusion=Follow up: read the remaining ncsi_rsp_handlers table bodies (ncsi-rsp.c:129-1080) for variable-length payload copies from skb_network_header(nr->rsp) that use attacker hdr->length and can exceed skb_headlen.
coverage_gap=No NCSI-capable driver (e.g. ftgmac100) was traced to confirm that a non-linear (frag/fraglist/GRO) skb can actually be delivered for ETH_P_NCSI 0x88F8 into ncsi_rcv_rsp in s05.
limitation=Both findings are source-reading hypotheses, not reproductions: no KASAN build, crafted non-linear NCSI frame, compilation, or runtime harness was run, so the read past skb_headlen (or of stale head bytes) is inferred from the accessor dereferences and the absence of any linearization call, not observed.
limitation=Because no pskb_may_pull() runs at all on this path, the concrete failure mode is an out-of-bounds read of the linear head area (bytes past skb_headlen into frags) rather than the seed's pskb_may_pull-induced slab use-after-free; the branch treats both as the same missing-linear-guarantee invariant.
limitation=Triggering requires CONFIG_NET_NCSI, a registered NCSI netdev (ncsi_register_dev -> dev_add_pack at ncsi-manage.c:1740), and an attacker able to inject frames on the NC-SI management side channel (often BMC-internal rather than internet-facing), so remote reachability is narrower than the seed's phonet case.
limitation=Most NIC RX drivers place received L2/L3 headers in the linear head, so a linear NCSI frame is harmless; the bug needs a driver/GRO configuration that puts the 6-16 NCSI header bytes in frags, which was not verified for any driver.
limitation=Line numbers and code state are valid only for snapshots/s05 as supplied; the snapshot revision is opaque, no git history, network access, or cross-snapshot comparison was used, and net/phonet/pep.c pep_get_sb was excluded per the branch rule.
